acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Goblins family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Runt, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Mob Harrier (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Knock-kneed and cringing in a filthy loincloth, with bare oversized feet, empty hands except for a sharpened stick, and almost no loot or protective gear.
Signature mechanic: Mob Nerve: the Runt stops cringing and makes rapid stick jabs only while shoulder-to-shoulder with another Goblin; when separated, it hesitates and backs toward the nearest ally.
battlefieldDuty: Flood open flanks, crowd isolated targets, and force the player to create breathing room before stronger Goblins arrive.
constructionDimensions: Materials and equipment become a stolen incendiary kit: oil-soaked rope, pitch-daubed door shields, heat-blued scrap, charred wood, ceramic fuel flasks, and fuse-bound cleavers remain visibly mismatched and field-repaired.
Silhouette and active effects expose fuel flow: high-mounted flask racks, trailing fuse cords, directional smoke, and pulsing shield-vent embers make ignition routes readable before flames spread.
counterplay: Displace or quickly remove one member of the cluster; the remaining Runt visibly cringes, pauses its jab chain, and can be cleared before it regroups. Affinity signal: A fuse spits bright sparks from flask to weapon or lootworks station before ignition; cutting that cord or breaking the clearly mounted fuel flask cancels the empowered action.
forbiddenTreatments: Uniform orange recolor without fuel-bearing construction changes
Glow-only fire treatment without visible fuel, combustion hardware, or heat response
Fire made from the Goblin's flesh rather than scavenged fuel and equipment
Clean forged flame armor that no longer reads as stolen scrap
identityInvariants: Short, hunched, long-armed humanoid silhouette with an oversized head and pointed ears, disproportionately large hands and feet, hooked nose, and crowded crooked teeth.
Sickly green or grey-green skin against muddy browns, rust-orange, dull iron, and sparse accents of stolen gold.
Every carried object reads as stolen, scavenged, or crudely repaired: rags, patched leather, cracked wood, rusted scrap metal, bone, and rope rather than purpose-built matching equipment.
Loot is the status language: mismatched helmets, coin necklaces, teeth, rings, captured banners, and trophies accumulate with rank.
Posture and finish communicate hierarchy, from a knock-kneed cringing crouch to an upright swagger amid increasingly prestigious plunder.
telegraph: Its knees straighten, ears lift, and the sharpened stick rises from a defensive clutch when another Goblin enters arm's reach.
